privacy.title: Privacy & GDPR
privacy.intro: SOLUSSIMO applies data protection by design.
privacy.data: Data processed: email address and password (handled by the authentication service, password hashed), display name, language, and your salon's management data.
privacy.purpose: Purpose: to provide the salon management service. No resale, no advertising trackers, no profiling.
privacy.isolation: Isolation: each business has a separate workspace; access rules are enforced directly in the database.
privacy.storage: Storage: hosting planned in the European Union. Data is kept while the account is active, then deleted.
privacy.rights: Your rights: access, rectification, export and erasure directly from "My account"; objection and restriction on request.
privacy.draft: Preliminary version: the final text (data controller, DPO contact, exact retention periods) will be approved before commercial launch.
